correctness.rationale: Transfer recurrence derived from mode-conditioned second moments. For p<1/2 the exact determinant equals eta times the cubic and is equivalent to Perron-root stability; symbolic discriminant identity, concave critical polynomial, continuous roots, and signs prove full interval classification. For p>=1/2 a PSD-similar matrix convex in eta proves one interval, including p=1. Exactly 520 rational tests and algebraic identities reproduced by package checker; finite tests are not the all-real proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The general spectral criterion covers how to decide stability at any fixed parameters, and must not be presented as novel. It does not explicitly classify topology of all admissible stepsizes as stay probability changes; eliminating eigenvalues and analyzing the complete cubic discriminant is necessary to obtain the claimed boundary. This comparison limits novelty to the fully worked algebraic phase diagram and does not deny the general prior machinery.

value.rationale: The model is an interpretable stochastic optimization benchmark with anti-persistent minibatch selection and sharply contrasting positive curvatures. A complete two-window vs one-window transition, with computable exact threshold and explicit contrasting stable/unstable learning rates, is a meaningful stability-design boundary not supplied by simply stating generic spectral criteria. No extrapolation to general objectives is asserted.
